pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/components/cli/useTaskQueue.ts:886 A user abort ends the run as success false, with no outcomeUnknown flag, so a killed Claude process is recorded as a failure while its in-flight tool effects are unknown.

techniques.evidence: src/components/cli/skills.ts:237 Skill packs are prompt text for a new session only; resume does not re-inject them, and nothing here registers a callback that runs on later sessions.

src/components/cli/CompactTerminal.tsx:80 A follow-up typed while the run is streaming is dropped, and TerminalInput marks the textarea readOnly for that time, so the message never joins the running unit.

src/components/cli/useTaskQueue.ts:886 Abort omits outcomeUnknown. An unobserved server loss is handled separately: runArbiter returns outcomeUnknown on not-found, and sessionRun stores success null only when that flag is set.

pairs.evidence: src/app/api/claude-terminal/stream/route.ts:134 When a finished execution is replayed, every status other than completed is sent as an error event, so an aborted run is delivered as a failure.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/claude-terminal/stream/route.ts:134 The execution type includes aborted, but this replay frame publishes only result or error. The client completion path switches on that event type.

src/lib/claude-terminal/mcp-config.ts:25 One-shot step sets enableMcp true, and buildCliArgs appends --mcp-config only from this env var; the request body cannot name the config path. A missing file warns and spawns without it.

pairs.evidence: src/app/api/cli-task-registry/route.ts:74 A running task whose heartbeat went stale is stored as failed when another start arrives, and the registry status type has no unknown value.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/cli-task-registry/route.ts:74 TaskStatus is only running, completed, or failed. The stale branch marks failed and then starts the new task; it does not return the old execution for the client to kill.
